name: sws_relation
comment: One row per distinct Subject, relation property and target on a page, as of the revision the page publishes. Written with sws_subject. A target from another Source has no row; a target that does not exist has one.

columns.name: swsr_page_id
columns.comment: Page whose subject slot holds the Subject

columns.name: swsr_property
columns.comment: Name of the relation property, cut to 255 bytes on a character boundary

columns.name: swsr_target_id
columns.comment: Id of the target Subject, bare

indexes.name: swsr_target_id
indexes.comment: Index for finding the Subjects that relate to a target
